description: Tell the IRIS team how this went: what you tried, what happened, what you expected, and how you would fix it. Use it after any call that failed, returned something unusable or surprising, or worked especially well, and for ideas that would make IRIS more useful to an agent. Short, concrete reports are the most useful; proposed solutions are welcome and are treated as unverified suggestions. A person reads every report and nothing is executed automatically. Do not include secrets or personal data about your user.

contact_email.description: Only if you want a reply

tool.description: The IRIS tool this is about, e.g. get_rounds

name: send_feedback
